_source: ALTA General Rules Adult Leagues, Fall 2026 (last revised Spring 2026): League-Specific Rules (pp. 8-11), Teams and Players I.E (roster minimums).
_how_lines_start: Lines play two per start slot. Lines 1-2 start at start_times[0], lines 3-4 at start_times[1], line 5 at start_times[2]. A later slot starts as listed or when a court is free, so a listed time is the earliest start. A line can take 1 to 3 hours (captain's note), so a later line can start late.
_not_covered: Wheelchair and Run/Roll leagues are not in the documents. Mixed Doubles line composition (which lines are men's, women's or mixed) is not stated in the documents, so line_kinds is null for it.

levels.note: A team's level flight reads like AA-3 or A-5. Lower numbers are stronger: AA-1 is the strongest team and C-8 the weakest, in the order AA-1..AA-3, A-1..A-8, B-1..B-8, C-1..C-8. Order and flight counts confirmed by the captain; the ALTA documents only say AA is the highest level and give flights 1-8 as an example. Rule I.G.5.i: a player added after schedules are posted must have a most recent final level at or below the team's level flight.
